meta.title: Secure checkout
meta.description: Sign in, enter your billing details and pay on our payment provider's secure page. Keys are issued to your account after payment is confirmed.

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.subtitle: Add a product to your cart to check out.

errors.checkFields: Check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

contact.title: Contact
contact.emailHint: We send the order confirmation, invoice and delivery updates here.

delivery.title: Receipt and billing
delivery.billingHint: The address registered with your card. It appears on your invoice.

review.title: Review & pay
review.accept: I have read and agree to the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms> and the <refunds>Refund policy</refunds>.
review.acceptLabelShort: Terms and Conditions and Refund policy
review.hosted: When you press Pay, you go to our payment provider's secure page to enter your card details. Card numbers are never typed into this site.
review.processedBy: Card payments are processed securely by {provider}. We never see or store your full card number.
review.processedByProvider: Card payments are processed securely by our PCI DSS compliant payment provider. We never see or store your full card number.
review.threeDs: Your bank may ask you to confirm the payment in your banking app (3-D Secure).
review.waiverNote: Without this request we cannot issue your keys. Once a key is issued, the {days}-day right to cancel no longer applies. <link>How cancelling works</link>.

merchant.tradingName: {brand} is a trading name of {company}. Company number {number}.

frame.credentials: {brand} is a trading name of {company}, company number {number}, {address}. {email}

paymentFailed.title: Your payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.body: You haven't been charged. Your details are still filled in, so you can try again.

problems.title: We couldn't take this order
problems.PAYMENTS_NOT_CONNECTED: Card payments are being connected. Nothing has been charged.
problems.PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Card payments are not available at the moment, so we can't take this order. Nothing has been charged. Please try again later or email {email}.
problems.PAYMENT_LINK_FAILED: We couldn't open the secure payment page. Nothing has been charged. Please try again in a few minutes.
problems.TOTAL_CHANGED: The price of a product or the exchange rate has changed, so your total is now {total}. Check it and press Pay again.
problems.ORDER_LIMIT: One order can hold up to {max} keys. Remove some from your cart to continue.
problems.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: {name} is no longer available. Remove it from your cart to continue.
problems.PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't confirm the current price and stock of {name}. Nothing has been charged. Please try again in a moment.
problems.AGE_REQUIRED: You must be {minAge} or over to order. Add your date of birth under Account → Profile, then come back to pay. Nothing has been charged.
problems.INVALID_REQUEST: Some details are missing or not valid. Check each step and try again.
problems.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
problems.UNAUTHORISED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
problems.NETWORK: We couldn't reach the store. Check your connection and try again.
problems.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing has been charged. Please try again.
problems.ITEM_LIMIT: You can buy up to {max} keys of {name} in one order. Lower the quantity to continue.
problems.ORDER_VALUE_LIMIT: One order can be worth up to {value}. Remove some products to continue.
problems.CUSTOMER_LIMIT: To protect cardholders, {type} are limited to {max} keys or {value} per customer in 24 hours. Nothing has been charged.

meta.title: Order confirmation
meta.description: The status of your Keyrook order and payment.

confirmed.when: Your keys appear on your order page, {usual}. We email you when they are ready.

checking.title: Checking your payment
checking.body: We're confirming the payment with our payment provider. This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.

failed.title: Your payment didn't go through
failed.body: You haven't been charged. The products are still in your cart, so you can try again or use another card.
failed.help: If money has left your account, email {email} and we'll look into it.

pending.title: Your payment is still being confirmed
pending.body: Your bank hasn't confirmed the payment yet. Please don't pay again. We'll email {email} as soon as it's confirmed, or contact {support} if you don't hear from us.

review.title: We're checking your payment
review.body: The payment confirmed by our provider doesn't match this order, so we've paused it before issuing any key. We'll contact you at {email} {replyTime}.

unavailable.title: We can't confirm this payment right now
unavailable.body: Our payment provider can't be reached at the moment, so we haven't marked the order as paid. We'll email {email} once it's confirmed, or contact {support}.

missing.title: No order to show
missing.body: This page shows an order after you pay. If you've just paid, use the link in your confirmation email or check your orders.

error.title: We couldn't load this order
error.notFound: We can't find an order for this payment.
error.generic: Something went wrong while checking the payment.
error.body: Nothing is lost. Try again in a moment, or email {email} with the time of your payment.

signIn.title: Sign in to check out
signIn.body: Keys are issued to your account, so checkout needs you to sign in. Your cart stays as it is while you sign in.
